pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Extra jumps, growing with the tier, up to +1.$(li)Fall damage reduction, growing with the tier, up to +45%%.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.

Will not count without:$(li)1 of Slime Block$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Slime Block$(li)Scaffolding$(li)Hay Bale$(li)Ladder$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)$(p)Counts against it:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)$(li)any crops

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Fences encloses floor, and slime is 1-4 from scaffolding, and scaffolding runs in a line of at least 3, best at 6.

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Fences: any fences$(li)Floor: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#structural)any structural$(/l)$(li)Slime: Slime Block$(li)Scaffolding: Scaffolding or Ladder
